sentences.text: Piscivoravis is an extinct genus of ornithuromorph dinosaurs, a group whose parent lineage is Ornithuromorpha.
This dinosaur specialized in eating fish.
The genus was first described by Shuang Zhou, Zhonghe Zhou, and Jingmai O'Connor in 2013, with the type species named Piscivoravis lii.
Phylogenetic analysis places Piscivoravis in a derived position relative to Archaeorhynchus, forming a polytomy with Jianchangornis, Patagopteryx, and more derived ornithuromorphs.
Fossils are found in the Early Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation of western Liaoning Province, northeastern China. These animals lived during the Aptian age, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
